title: A-MEM — paper view
subtitle: The mechanism as Xu et al. describe it. Lane = canonical stage (METHODOLOGY-SKELETON §2.2); empty lanes mean the paper defines no such step.
source: Xu et al. 2025, A-MEM (arXiv:2502.12110v11)   ·   every anchor re-located during verification (servers/amem/verification.md §2/§3, 56 ARCHITECTURE.md assertions: 40 ✓ / 1 ✗ / 13 ◐ / 2 ?)
legend_notes: B1 CUE is empty: Eq.8-10 fold query encoding into one cosine top-k step — the paper never treats query embedding as its own stage.
Linked-memory auto-access (Fig.2 caption, txt:296-297) sits outside the formal Eq.8-10 treatment — drawn with seq: null because the equations never mention it.
The write path is almost entirely LLM-driven: three separate prompted roles (Ps1 construct, Ps2 link, Ps3 evolve) touch every new note; only the embedding step (Eq.3) is not an LLM call.
A6 / B4 / B5 / B8 are empty by design — A-MEM defines no training, no reranking or fusion, no combinatorial selection, and no retrieval loop.

nodes.label: IO:TurnPair — interaction content c_i, timestamp t_i

LLM:Evolve — per-neighbor revise: m_j* replaces m_j for each m_j in M_near (Ps3)
Store:Vector — memory set M (new note + updated m_j*)
